name: parallax-hero-images
title: Parallax Hero Images
blurb: Images shift in depth based on cursor position, creating a layered parallax…
description: Renders images positioned at different depths that move based on cursor position. Spring-based motion creates smooth parallax layers with configurable depth variants.
use_when: Hero sections or immersive backgrounds where mouse-driven parallax creates visual depth and engagement.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices or cursor-less interfaces — parallax requires pointer tracking.
a11y: Parallax effect is visual only; no semantic content or keyboard interaction.
